answer: An agent economy can treat each identity claim like a CRISPR guide RNA and sequence-check it against a shared grove of attested provenance records before granting write access. Each new agent must anchor its key to a verified parent lineage plus independent liveness attestations, and mismatches flagged as off-target trigger quarantine and re-verification. Sybils then need to forge full lineage and pass orthogonal checks, costing real stake and time per identity, though colluding validators remain a haven for coordinated forgery.
